## Où j'en suis
Built cmd/replay on lior/replay-12-11 with dry run, per-partition ordering, rejects output, and a hard allowlist for events.replay.v3 only. The 12/11 dry run finished with 18,442,107 events to replay and 3,118 schema-v2 rejects; PR #233 is open for Daniel’s review.

- [prochaine-étape] After Daniel reviews, run the real replay into events.replay.v3, then the aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12.
- [essai-raté] dry-run-1 with batch 50k timed out and was OOMKilled at 2Gi; batch 5k completed at 310 MiB.
- [essai-raté] Early tests found out-of-order events because workers mixed partitions; splitting workers by partition fixed it.
- [décision] Replay the full 12/11 window only to events.replay.v3, never events.v3; aggregates will be recomputed by --backfill. (source: t05)
- [décision] Use batch 5k and do not change the memory limit. (source: t13)
- [décision] Do not draft the Fernhill/Orbitly ETA; you will give it yourself after Daniel reviews. (source: t19)
